fees.notes: UPNM Centre for Graduate Studies official international postgraduate fee structure (approved by the 60th University Board, 28 Aug 2025): research-mode tuition per semester is faculty-dependent - Master RM2,400-RM7,200 and PhD RM3,000-RM8,010. Total payable per semester including service (RM450), health (RM50), insurance (RM50) and postgraduate development/activity (RM50): Master RM3,150-RM7,950 (first semester), RM3,000-RM7,800 (subsequent); PhD RM3,750-RM8,760 (first), RM3,600-RM8,610 (subsequent). A single total/per-year is not published because the programme is offered across faculties at different rates. Sources: https://cgs.upnm.edu.my/index.php/postgraduate-study/127-fee-structure and https://cgs.upnm.edu.my/images/Final_New_PG_FEE_-_KADAR_YURAN_BAHARU_PROG_PASCASISWAZAH_PPS_2025__KEMASKINI_29102025_to_RIFAD_Page_1.jpg (Page_1-Page_4) (accessed 2026-09-18).
